geometry.bevelScope: four bottom perimeter edges at Z=-0.08 only; exclude top edges and vertical edges; corner blends remain within the bottom 0.003 m band

modules.name: Road markings - shared paint with path presets
modules.origin: each straight piece at centre; curved piece at arc centre; all on Z=0

paint.alphaRule: outside and wear holes transparent; no asphalt, brick or stone RGB baked into pigment
paint.reviewProjection: top only; no thickness or road slab needed for side views
paint.sourcePNGRole: appearance reference only; not a seamless shared paint texture or a production mask for arbitrary paths
paint.lightingContent: no lights, emission, shadow, AO, ground fill or halo in production texture

modules.drawingInterpretation: The three pieces are independently placeable path presets sharing paint, not separate fixed mesh or shape-specific material deliverables. paint.alphaRule: outside and wear holes transparent; no asphalt, brick or stone RGB baked into pigment
paint.reviewProjection: top only; no thickness or road slab needed for side views

modules.drawingInterpretation: Approved transparent v4 drawing: exactly one independent bar, no receiving surface or array. Numeric dimensions define the local-space rectangle.
modules.repetition: app chooses count and gap; no fixed group size
modules.repetitionAxis: local X; position/count/gap selected by app

modules.name: Pavement and curb - individual units
modules.drawingInterpretation: assembled appearance reference only; paving stones and curb blocks are independent units, not one fixed L-shaped mesh

pieces.bevelScope: all outer edges, inward within unchanged overall bounds
all outer edges, inward within unchanged overall bounds
pieces.shape: straight preset of the shared planar curb section; see PLANAR-CURBS.md

pieces.bevelScope: top and bottom boundary loops plus four vertical radial-end corners; exclude intermediate arc tessellation seams; inward surface offset with two segments, without expanding the nominal envelope
pieces.shape: circular-arc preset of the shared planar curb section; see PLANAR-CURBS.md

assemblyNotes.curvedRuns: app generates the shared section along planar paths; continuous or separately capped pieces follow PLANAR-CURBS.md
assemblyNotes.cutting: curbs may be split by centreline arc length; arbitrary solid trimming and paver cutting remain outside scope

modules.name: Round manhole cover
modules.drawingInterpretation: Topology and numeric modeling dimensions accepted by user on 2026-10-07: raised centre disk and rings 2/4, base-plane rings 1/3, six radial blind recesses, separable cover/frame and 4 mm radial gap. Dimensioned v2 synchronizes the accepted contract; its final annotation layout was approved by the user on 2026-10-07. Original appearance source is unchanged; annotated v1 is historical. Section is schematic, not to scale. Ring radii are rounded image-derived estimates; common 1 mm rise and edge treatment are accepted authored decisions, not measured heights. Numeric specification controls geometry.
modules.origin: centre of rim TOP on road surface, Z=0

orderFromCentre: outer field - base plane with six capsule recesses
radialProfile.status: Numeric modeling definition accepted by user on 2026-10-07. Consecutive boundary pairs map to orderFromCentre. Ring radii are rounded image-derived estimates; common 1 mm rise and relief bevel are accepted authored choices. Former narrow-groove dimensions are withdrawn.
radialProfile.bodyZRangeInterpretation: Base body Z=-0.021 to -0.001 m; raised centre and rings 2/4 reach Z=0. Cover maximum thickness is 0.021 m; assembly remains Z=-0.026 to 0 m.
radialProfile.edgeTreatment: Nominal transitions at the listed radii are vertical 1 mm steps. Bevel only the convex upper circular edge of each transition: 0.0002 m inward surface offset, two segments, profile 0.5. Leave concave feet sharp; never cut below the base plane. Do not bevel tessellation seams. Boundaries are nominal pre-bevel radii.

slots.shape: radially aligned capsule with semicircular ends; blind recess

surface.wearOn: rim edge and relief boundaries only

mounting.rule: rim top flush to road; remove intersecting road top faces, not stack a disk above road; keep cover and rim separate solids and preserve the nominal 0.004 m radial clearance
mounting.interaction: not implemented; cover and rim must support independent transforms without shared vertices or bridging geometry

modules.name: Street tree
modules.origin: trunk base centre on planting ground, Z=0

silhouetteEnvelopeMetres.role: maximum envelope; do not scale or clip to fill it

modules.status: User delegated the remaining dimensions and construction choices; finalized 2026-10-08. Canonical tree-only numeric definitions are in tree-construction-spec.json; old sparse branch and uniform foliage recipes are superseded. No model has been generated or visually accepted.

modules.name: Street lantern
modules.origin: foot base centre on pavement, Z=0
modules.radialSymmetry: Fourfold head about +Z; axisymmetric foot, shaft, collars, neck and finial. All centres X=Y=0.

foot.profileInterpolation: shape-preserving cubic Hermite r(z), defined in LANTERN-SPEC.md
foot.caps: flat closed bottom; remove buried upper cap at structural union

shaft.caps: remove buried end caps inside collars

glass.thicknessDirection: along the sloped pane inward unit normal; paired back face is translated, not scaled
glass.construction: Planar trapezoids with inward-translated backs and closed edge walls; exact vertices in LANTERN-SPEC.md. Glass overlaps metal only inside its concealed 4 mm seat.

frame.construction: Truncated square shell with four face windows cut out; retains four L-section corner posts, continuous upper/lower rings and solid bottom tray. Exact set definitions in LANTERN-SPEC.md.
frame.bevelRule: Exposed metal convex edges only, inward constant-distance chamfer rounded by three arc segments; exclude glass contact seats, part interfaces and buried edges. Preserve authored outer extrema.

roof.shellThicknessDirection: normal distance from each unrounded outer plane
roof.shape: Closed hollow square hip roof with underside lid; subtract the exact enclosed cavity defined in LANTERN-SPEC.md.
roof.bevelRule: Inward rounding on four exterior vertical eave corners and upper/lower eave perimeter only. Keep four hip creases and peak attachment plane sharp; no geometry overhang beyond 0.53 m square.

finial.profileInterpolation: same cubic Hermite rule, except the final derivative equals the spherical-cap derivative
finial.construction: Revolve the profile, then continue the exact spherical cap to its welded top pole. Do not cap the profile at the sphere join or add another sphere underneath.

surface.appliesTo: Default lamp-metal and collar-metal only; amber panes use uniform intrinsic colour. Replacing a material removes this grain recipe.

modules.dimensionStatus: Recalculated 2026-10-08 from FRONT proportions with retained authored height 2.74 m. Pixel readings are approximate; hidden geometry and rounded metric values are authoring decisions. No model acceptance.

proportionSource.rule: Use FRONT for proportional reconstruction; SIDE checks fourfold symmetry, TOP checks square roof and centred finial. Do not turn drawn base ellipses into a pointed physical base.

joins.structuralRule: Union foot, shaft, collars, neck and frame tray; remove all buried faces. Exterior face ownership determines independently replaceable appearance slots. Roof and finial attach at specified planes with hidden coincident interface faces removed.
joins.glassRule: Keep four closed panes separate, subtract their exact occupied solids from concealed metal seats; exposed frame openings stay unchanged. No coplanar visible faces.

appearanceOverrides.scope: Each component has independent colour and full material replacement; the four panes may share a slot or override individually. This is a construction contract, not an implemented API.
appearanceOverrides.colourRule: Select material first, then apply per-part colour, otherwise group colour, if explicitly supplied. No colour override means preserve selected material colour.
appearanceOverrides.replacementRule: Full material replacement discards the previous shader and textures. A colour override changes tint only and preserves the selected material remaining properties. No geometry displacement, dimension/origin changes or mutation of another instance.
appearanceOverrides.defaultLighting: opaque panes; no emission, bulb geometry, light objects or baked shadows/AO/highlights. App owns optional illumination.

verification.framing: entire module plus 10 percent margin, equal front and side pixels per metre
verification.albedoReview: unlit colors, no shadows, no AO, no bloom
verification.lightingReview: later modeling task only, temporary scene lights not saved into module
verification.status: criteria only, no model verification performed
verification.paintSurfaceCaseRule: same unchanged marking pigment and alpha on each receiving surface; surface visible outside and through wear holes; no surface image stored in unit

deliverables.unitDrawings: v4 transparent paint units; v2 solid appearance sheets; pavement assembly is appearance-only, with individual stone dimensions specified
